question: Which additional goddesses are included together with Śrī in this continuing enumeration?
premises: The word tathā signals continuation of the preceding list.
Indrāṇī and Cāmuṇḍā are named as included figures.
The phrase śriyā saha indicates accompaniment together with Śrī.
inference: The enumeration continues by adding Indrāṇī and Cāmuṇḍā together with Śrī.
plain_english: Likewise, Indrāṇī and Cāmuṇḍā are included together with Śrī.
